depositInsurance.value: Up to ₹5 lakh per depositor per bank (DICGC)

institutions.retirementSystem: EPF for salaried workers, plus NPS and PPF
institutions.unemploymentNote: Most workers have no general unemployment benefit, so savings and family are the main safety net. Some insured workers can claim limited ESIC support.

cashAtHome.name: Cash at home
cashAtHome.note: Loses value to inflation and can be lost or stolen.

everydayAccount.name: Bank savings account
everydayAccount.note: Linked to UPI for daily payments; low interest.

savingsAccount.name: Recurring deposit / FD
savingsAccount.note: Fixed monthly deposit at a bank; protected up to ₹5 lakh by DICGC.

indexFund.name: Nifty 50 index fund SIP
indexFund.note: Systematic Investment Plan into an index fund. Value goes up and down; long-term average historically positive.

informalSavings.name: Chit fund
informalSavings.description: A group pools a fixed amount every month and one member takes the pot each month, often by auction. Registered chit funds are regulated under the Chit Funds Act; unregistered ones carry fraud risk.

bigLifeEvent.name: Family wedding
bigLifeEvent.note: Weddings are major family expenses and a common reason households take on debt.

culture.familySupport: Your parents need money for a sibling's education
notes: Supporting parents financially is a widely shared expectation.
Gold is a traditional store of value, especially for women's savings.

scams.message: Collect request ₹4,999. Enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE payment for your sofa.
scams.tell: You never enter your UPI PIN to receive money. A PIN only ever sends money.

scams.message: Dear customer, your account will be BLOCKED today. Update PAN KYC here: sbi-kyc-update.in
scams.tell: Urgency plus a lookalike link. Banks ask you to visit the branch or official app for KYC.

scams.message: A parcel with drugs was booked on your Aadhaar. You are under digital arrest. Transfer funds for verification.
scams.tell: 'Digital arrest' does not exist in Indian law. Police never ask you to transfer money. Report at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.

scams.message: Earn ₹5,000/day liking YouTube videos! Pay ₹999 registration to start.
scams.tell: Paying to get a job is a red flag. Task scams start small and then ask for bigger deposits.

scams.message: ₹250 debited from A/c XX1234 to Swiggy via UPI. Not you? Call the number on your card.
scams.tell: A debit alert for a payment you made, with no link, is normal. If unsure, call the number on your card.

scams.message: OTP 482913 for your login on iMobile. Do NOT share it with anyone, including bank staff.
scams.tell: An OTP you requested yourself is legitimate. The message itself warns you not to share it.
